items.summary: Legal risk disposition: blocked for the gated product public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep the gated product private, keep external outreach unsent, authorize no monetization expansion, and continue only existing evidence, repair-or-close, and measurement reconciliation. Evidence: official API documentation establishes access mechanics but not public/commercial reuse rights; current terms point against the proposed data use. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, 10 unknown, with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is configured for 39 sites, with source-permission errors; incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary reversible growth. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission is not site-attributable and site-attributed commission is $0; ROI and margin remain unknown. Security, accuracy/freshness, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. This is risk triage, not legal advice or certification; human counsel is required before any rights-dependent launch or monetization decision.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed and 4 remain open. No task is closed because evidence is partial. Open tasks are source rights; alert-data flow and retention; GA4 consent and configuration; and logs, vendors, and incident handling. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, change the private gate, enable tracking, or expand monetization.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked; missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, permitted storage/caching/display/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price limits, and affiliate or advertising limits. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional privacy review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Retain containment-only execution. Continue existing failure repair-or-close, period-aligned measurement and attribution reconciliation, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence. Preserve unknowns; create no new production work, requeues, experiments, duplicate telemetry, dependencies, spend, monetization expansion, or unsupported claims. The exact next legal evidence action is the consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix. No launch-readiness task is closed.
